actionCalls.description: Sends the FQS Gift Acknowledgement template (full deduction) to the donor's PersonContact using the emailSimple v3 template-aware action. recipientId is the PersonContactId so template merge fields resolve against the Contact record. relatedRecordId is the current GiftTransaction so amount/date merge fields resolve.
actionCalls.name: Send_Email_Full
actionCalls.label: Send Acknowledgement Email (Full Deduction Template)

actionCalls.description: Sends the FQS Gift Acknowledgement (Partial Deduction) template. Used when TaxDeductionAmount is less than CurrentAmount — the template states the specific deductible amount rather than the no-goods-or-services blanket statement.
actionCalls.name: Send_Email_Partial
actionCalls.label: Send Acknowledgement Email (Partial Deduction Template)

actionCalls.description: Catch-all fault handler. On any critical element failure, sends $Flow.FaultMessage to the running user's email.
actionCalls.name: Send_Fault_Email
actionCalls.label: Send Fault Email

assignments.description: Extracts DonorId from each fetched GiftTransaction into a String collection so donor Accounts and open Opportunities can be pre-fetched in a single query each.
assignments.name: Build_DonorIds
assignments.label: Build: Donor Id Collection

assignments.description: Extracts PersonContactId from each fetched donor Account into a String collection so the Contact records driving email routing can be pre-fetched in one query.
assignments.name: Build_ContactIds
assignments.label: Build: Person Contact Id Collection

assignments.description: Resets per-iteration tracking variables at the top of each main loop iteration. Prevents previous-iteration state from leaking into the current gift on edge cases where an inner Match loop yields zero iterations (org donor with no PersonContactId, donor with no open opportunities, etc.).
assignments.name: Reset_Iter_Vars
assignments.label: Reset Per-Iteration Variables

assignments.description: Copies scalar fields from the matched donor Account into per-iteration tracking variables. Runs inside a single-record inner loop because the collection filter output is a 1-record collection.
assignments.name: Set_Account_Vars
assignments.label: Set Account Match Variables

assignments.description: Copies scalar fields from the matched donor Contact into per-iteration tracking variables so routing decisions no longer need to dereference the SObject repeatedly.
assignments.name: Set_Contact_Vars
assignments.label: Set Contact Match Variables

assignments.description: Captures the first (soonest CloseDate) open Opportunity for this donor. Pre-fetched collection is already sorted CloseDate ASC, so the first inner-loop iteration is the soonest — the varOppFound flag prevents subsequent iterations from overwriting.
assignments.name: Set_Opp_Vars
assignments.label: Set Opportunity Match Variables (First Only)

assignments.description: No open opportunity found — task WhatId falls back to the donor Account.
assignments.name: Set_WhatId_To_Account
assignments.label: Set WhatId to Account

assignments.description: Open opportunity found — task WhatId is the soonest-closing open opportunity Id so the acknowledgement task surfaces alongside active pipeline.
assignments.name: Set_WhatId_To_Opportunity
assignments.label: Set WhatId to Opportunity

assignments.description: Builds a Task sObject in memory using the per-iteration variables and appends it to the varTasksToInsert record collection for post-loop bulk insert. Replaces the per-iteration Create_Acknowledgement_Task DML from the pre-bulkification design.
assignments.name: Build_Task_Record
assignments.label: Build Task Record and Append

assignments.description: Builds a GiftTransaction update record stamping AcknowledgementStatus = Sent and AcknowledgementDate = today, then appends it to the varGTsToUpdate collection for post-loop bulk update.
assignments.name: Build_GT_Update_Sent
assignments.label: Build GT Update (Sent) and Append

assignments.description: Builds a GiftTransaction update record stamping AcknowledgementStatus = To Be Sent, then appends it to the varGTsToUpdate collection for post-loop bulk update. AcknowledgementDate is left blank until the queue member completes the personal outreach.
assignments.name: Build_GT_Update_ToBeSent
assignments.label: Build GT Update (To Be Sent) and Append

collectionProcessors.description: Filters the pre-fetched donor Account collection to just the record whose Id matches the current gift's DonorId. Yields a single-record collection consumed by Loop_Match_Account.
collectionProcessors.name: Filter_Account_By_Donor
collectionProcessors.label: Filter: Donor Account by DonorId

collectionProcessors.description: Filters the pre-fetched Contact collection to just the record whose Id matches the current donor's PersonContactId. Yields a single-record collection consumed by Loop_Match_Contact.
collectionProcessors.name: Filter_Contact_By_PersonContactId
collectionProcessors.label: Filter: Contact by PersonContactId

collectionProcessors.description: Filters the pre-fetched open-Opportunity collection to just those on the current donor Account. Pre-fetch is already sorted CloseDate ASC so first-hit inside Loop_Match_Opp is the soonest.
collectionProcessors.name: Filter_Opps_By_Donor
collectionProcessors.label: Filter: Open Opportunities by DonorId

decisions.description: WhatId resolution. Open opportunity if found (soonest CloseDate); donor Account otherwise. Gates on varOppFound rather than dereferencing the Opp variable directly.
decisions.name: Opp_Found
decisions.label: Open Opportunity Found?

decisions.description: Full-vs-partial-deduction template selection. Uses partial template when TaxDeductionAmount is non-null and less than CurrentAmount; otherwise uses the full-deduction template.
decisions.name: Route_Email_Template
decisions.label: Route: Full or Partial Deduction Template?

decisions.description: Universal acknowledgement routing rule — every donor gets a receipt. Email path requires: (1) Contact has not opted out of email, AND (2) Contact has a non-blank Email address. Any single failing condition routes to the Task path so the queue member can send the acknowledgement by mail or another channel. No donor-tier / CMDT / lifetime-donor filtering here — acknowledgement is universal; those tier considerations live in the FQS_Stewardship_Response flow.
decisions.name: Route_Email_Or_Task
decisions.label: Route: Email or Task?

decisions.description: Ensures Set_Opp_Vars fires only on the first inner-loop iteration (the soonest opportunity, because the pre-fetch is sorted ASC). Subsequent iterations skip back to the inner loop without overwriting.
decisions.name: Decide_First_Opp
decisions.label: Decide: First Opportunity Iteration?

Flow.description:
Bulk-safe scheduled flow that runs daily at 06:00 UTC and processes GiftTransaction records where Status = Paid, TransactionDate is at least 3 days in the past, AcknowledgementStatus is blank, and category is not Other. The 3-day window lets digital-platform ingest and refunds/reversals settle before an acknowledgement fires. Other category is excluded — donors don't get receipts for earned income / event registration / processing-fee records.
Acknowledgement is the universal "we got your gift, thanks, here is your deduction info" touch — every donor with a valid email address receives one. No donor-tier / lifetime-donor filtering; every eligible gift gets a receipt. Tier-based routing lives in the FQS_Stewardship_Response flow.
Bulkification design: all SOQL fires pre-loop (Queue, GiftTransactions, donor Accounts, donor Contacts, open Opportunities) and all DML fires post-loop (bulk-insert acknowledgement Tasks, bulk-update GiftTransaction acknowledgement stamps). The main loop performs no SOQL and no DML — it uses Collection Filter elements against pre-fetched collections to resolve donor Account, donor Contact, and soonest open Opportunity, then either dispatches an emailSimple action or appends a Task record and a GT-update record to post-loop collections. Email dispatch is unavoidably per-recipient and stays inside the loop.
For each qualifying gift the flow: (1) resolves donor Account, donor Contact, and soonest open Opportunity from pre-fetched collections; (2) routes to email or task on a universal rule — email if HasOptedOutOfEmail = false AND Email is not blank, task otherwise; (3) builds the appropriate Sent or To Be Sent GT stamp into a collection.
Email path: sends the FQS Gift Acknowledgement template (or the Partial Deduction variant when TaxDeductionAmount < CurrentAmount) via the emailSimple v3 template-aware action to the donor PersonContact; appends AcknowledgementStatus = Sent, AcknowledgementDate = today to the update collection.
Task path: appends a Task record owned by the FQS Gift Acknowledgements queue with WhatId set to the soonest open opportunity (or donor Account fallback) to the insert collection; appends AcknowledgementStatus = To Be Sent to the update collection. Queue member completes the personal outreach and closes the task manually, then sets AcknowledgementStatus = Sent.
Pickup filter is AcknowledgementStatus IS NULL only. Records stamped To Be Sent are excluded from future runs so the task path does not create duplicate tasks day-over-day. Once the queue member closes out the outreach they set AcknowledgementStatus = Sent.
External-tool contract: donation-form integrations that send their own acknowledgement MUST write GiftTransaction.AcknowledgementStatus = 'Sent' back to the record so this flow's filter (AcknowledgementStatus IS NULL) skips them.
Year-end tax receipting is out of scope for automation; see FQS_Tax_Receipt_Date__c for the manual capture field.
Fault connectors on all SOQL, DML, and action elements route to Send_Fault_Email which notifies $User.Email.

formulas.description: The date boundary used in the Get_GiftTransactions filter. Only gifts whose TransactionDate is on or before this date are included, preserving the 3-day settling window.
formulas.name: frmThreeDaysAgo

formulas.description: Task activity date. +7 days from today — a standard SLA for personal acknowledgement outreach on gifts that couldn't receive an auto-email. Tier-scaled SLAs (Major +3, Mid +7, Entry +14) live in the stewardship flow, not here.
formulas.name: frmTaskActivityDate

formulas.description: Task Description. Explains why the acknowledgement couldn't be auto-emailed (opt-out or missing email) and surfaces related open opportunity context if any.
formulas.name: frmTaskDescription
formulas.expression: "Personal acknowledgement needed — automated email could not be sent. Reason: " & IF({!varCurrentContactOptedOut}, "Contact opted out of email.", IF(ISBLANK({!varCurrentContactEmail}), "No email address on Contact.", "Unknown.")) & " Related open opportunity: " & IF({!varOppFound}, {!varCurrentOppName}, "none") & "."

formulas.description: Task subject. Prepends [OPT-OUT — send by mail] when the donor has opted out of email so the queue member knows immediately to use a non-email channel.
formulas.name: frmTaskSubject

Flow.label: FQS Gift Acknowledgement

loops.description: Iterates over the fetched GiftTransaction collection to build a String collection of donor Ids for the bulk donor Account and Opportunity queries.
loops.name: Loop_Build_DonorIds
loops.label: Loop: Build Donor Ids

loops.description: Iterates over the fetched donor Account collection to build a String collection of PersonContact Ids for the bulk Contact query.
loops.name: Loop_Build_ContactIds
loops.label: Loop: Build Person Contact Ids

loops.description: Main iteration over qualifying GiftTransactions. Performs no SOQL and no DML — resolves donor context from pre-fetched collections and either dispatches an email or appends to the post-loop Task insert and GT update collections.
loops.name: Loop_GiftTransactions
loops.label: Loop: Gift Transactions to Acknowledge

loops.description: Single-iteration inner loop that copies the filtered donor Account's scalar fields (Id, Name, PersonContactId) into per-iteration variables. Yields exactly one iteration because collection filter output is a 1-record collection keyed on Id.
loops.name: Loop_Match_Account
loops.label: Loop: Match Donor Account

loops.description: Single-iteration inner loop that copies the filtered Contact's Email and HasOptedOutOfEmail into per-iteration variables so Route_Email_Or_Task and the task formulas can read scalars rather than SObject fields.
loops.name: Loop_Match_Contact
loops.label: Loop: Match Donor Contact

loops.description: Iterates over the filtered open Opportunities for this donor. Pre-fetch is sorted CloseDate ASC and the Set_Opp_Vars assignment only overwrites when varOppFound is false, so the first (soonest) opportunity is captured. Zero iterations when the donor has no open opportunities.
loops.name: Loop_Match_Opp
loops.label: Loop: Match Soonest Open Opportunity

recordCreates.description: Bulk-inserts all acknowledgement Tasks accumulated during the main loop in a single DML statement. Replaces the per-iteration Create_Acknowledgement_Task pattern from the pre-bulkification design.
recordCreates.name: Insert_Tasks
recordCreates.label: Insert Acknowledgement Tasks (Bulk)

recordLookups.description: Bulk-fetches all donor Accounts referenced by the qualifying GiftTransactions in one query. Populates Name and PersonContactId for downstream task subject and email recipient resolution.
recordLookups.name: Get_Donor_Accounts
recordLookups.label: Get Donor Accounts (Bulk)

recordLookups.description: Bulk-fetches all donor Contacts referenced by the fetched donor Accounts in one query. HasOptedOutOfEmail and Email drive Route_Email_Or_Task.
recordLookups.name: Get_Contacts
recordLookups.label: Get Donor Contacts (Bulk)

recordLookups.description: Queries all GiftTransaction records that qualify for acknowledgement: Status = Paid, TransactionDate on or before frmThreeDaysAgo, AcknowledgementStatus IS NULL, and category is not Other. Note the filter dropped its previous "OR AcknowledgementStatus = To Be Sent" clause — records stamped To Be Sent are now excluded from future runs to prevent duplicate task creation on the task-path day over day. External-tool integrations that already sent their own thank-you should have written AcknowledgementStatus = Sent to opt out of this flow.
recordLookups.name: Get_GiftTransactions
recordLookups.label: Get Gift Transactions to Acknowledge

recordLookups.description: Bulk-fetches all open Opportunities on donor Accounts referenced by the qualifying gifts in one query, sorted CloseDate ASC so the first-matching per-donor record inside Loop_Match_Opp is the soonest. Most donors — especially one-time entry donors — will have no open opportunity; the empty case is handled by the varOppFound flag.
recordLookups.name: Get_Open_Opportunities
recordLookups.label: Get Open Opportunities (Bulk)

recordLookups.description: Fetches the FQS_Gift_Acknowledgements queue Group record by DeveloperName so its Id can be used as Task.OwnerId. Fetched once pre-loop.
recordLookups.name: Get_Queue_Id
recordLookups.label: Get FQS Gift Acknowledgements Queue

recordUpdates.description: Bulk-updates all GiftTransaction acknowledgement stamps accumulated during the main loop in a single DML statement. Handles both Sent (email path) and To Be Sent (task path) writes.
recordUpdates.name: Update_GTs
recordUpdates.label: Update Gift Transaction Stamps (Bulk)

variables.description: Scratch iterator required by Filter_Account_By_Donor. Salesforce collection filter conditions reference the current-item scalar under this variable name; it is never read outside the filter's conditions block.
variables.name: filterItem_Account

variables.description: Scratch iterator required by Filter_Contact_By_PersonContactId. Never read outside the filter's conditions block.
variables.name: filterItem_Contact

variables.description: Scratch iterator required by Filter_Opps_By_Donor. Never read outside the filter's conditions block.
variables.name: filterItem_Opp

variables.description: Collection of donor Ids extracted from Get_GiftTransactions for the bulk Account and Opportunity queries.
variables.name: varDonorIds

variables.description: Collection of PersonContact Ids extracted from Get_Donor_Accounts for the bulk Contact query.
variables.name: varContactIds

variables.description: Per-iteration scalar copy of the matched donor Account Id. Used as Task WhatId fallback when the donor has no open opportunity.
variables.name: varCurrentAccountId

variables.description: Per-iteration scalar copy of the matched donor Account Name. Populates the task subject.
variables.name: varCurrentAccountName

variables.description: Per-iteration scalar copy of the matched donor Account's PersonContactId. Used as emailSimple recipientId and Task WhoId.
variables.name: varCurrentPersonContactId

variables.description: Per-iteration scalar copy of the matched donor Contact's Email address. Drives Route_Email_Or_Task email-vs-task decision.
variables.name: varCurrentContactEmail

variables.description: Per-iteration scalar copy of the matched donor Contact's HasOptedOutOfEmail flag. Drives Route_Email_Or_Task and the opt-out prefix in the task subject.
variables.name: varCurrentContactOptedOut

variables.description: Per-iteration scalar copy of the soonest open Opportunity Id for the current donor, or blank when no open opportunity exists.
variables.name: varCurrentOppId

variables.description: Per-iteration scalar copy of the soonest open Opportunity Name for the current donor. Surfaces in the task Description formula when present.
variables.name: varCurrentOppName

variables.description: Per-iteration flag toggled by Set_Opp_Vars on the first inner-loop iteration. Prevents subsequent iterations of Loop_Match_Opp from overwriting the soonest opportunity, and gates the Opp_Found decision.
variables.name: varOppFound

variables.description: Holds the WhatId for the acknowledgement Task for the current loop iteration. Set by Set_WhatId_To_Opportunity or Set_WhatId_To_Account.
variables.name: varTaskWhatId

variables.description: Scratch scalar Task record populated field-by-field in Build_Task_Record then appended to varTasksToInsert.
variables.name: varTaskBuilder

variables.description: Post-loop insert collection of acknowledgement Task records accumulated across all task-path iterations. Written to the database in one DML statement by Insert_Tasks.
variables.name: varTasksToInsert

variables.description: Scratch scalar GiftTransaction record populated in Build_GT_Update_Sent or Build_GT_Update_ToBeSent then appended to varGTsToUpdate.
variables.name: varGTUpdateBuilder

variables.description: Post-loop update collection of GiftTransaction records with AcknowledgementStatus (and AcknowledgementDate on the Sent branch) stamped. Written to the database in one DML statement by Update_GTs.
variables.name: varGTsToUpdate
